description: Delete an event. The user reviews this call by its `title`, and a title that does not match the event is refused. For recurring events pass `scope` ("instance" removes one occurrence, "series" removes all).

scope.description: Required for recurring events: "instance" = only this occurrence, "series" = every occurrence.

title.description: The title of the event being deleted, exactly as list_events or search_events returned it.

name: delete_event
